channel.title: Supabase incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Supabase's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Unresponsive Projects [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Brief connection disruptions in us-east-1 (N. Virginia) [resolved]
item.description: Between 05:50–06:05 UTC some customer using Supavisor in us-east-1 may have experienced brief dropped connections or connection disruptions. This issue was caused by an unexpected restart of Supavisor instances in the affected cluster. We apologize for any disruption caused.

item.title: Project Lifecycle Actions Showing increased error rates across all regions [resolved]
item.description: Lifecycle operations have been re-enabled for 100% of users and error rates have returned to normal.

item.title: User unable to log in to Supabase Dashboard [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Users should now be able to log in to the Supabase Dashboard normally. Projects and non-Dashboard traffic were unaffected throughout the incident.

item.title: Project Creation Failures [resolved]
item.description: Project creation has returned to baseline consistently.

item.title: Projects failing to load Supautils in multiple regions [resolved]
item.description: PostgreSQL 15 projects were failing to load /usr/lib/postgresql/15/lib/supautils.so because GLIBC_2.33 is unavailable on affected hosts. This disrupted database access in multiple regions. Rollback is now complete and we are seeing access restored to projects in the affected regions.

item.title: Increased response times for requests [resolved]
item.description: Response times have recovered in all regions. This issue is now resolved.

item.title: pgBouncer issues on some older projects [resolved]
item.description: The fix has remained stable across all regions, and the issue has been resolved.

item.title: Increased rates of Pooler connection timeouts in us-east-1 [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Issues affecting automatic disk resizing [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting automatic disk resizing has been resolved. We will continue to follow up directly with affected users who opened a support ticket.

item.title: Error spikes in one of the ap-northeast-2 Supavisor clusters [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved.

item.title: Error spikes in one of the eu-east-1 Supavisor clusters [resolved]
item.description:
Between 04:54 and 04:58 UTC we observed error spikes in one of the eu-east-1 Supavisor clusters. Users would have experienced errors in connecting to postgres via Supavisor. The issue has since recovered.
Errors reported: ClientHandler: (ECHECKOUTTIMEOUT) unable to check out connection from the pool after 15000ms in Transaction mode.

item.title: Delays in project provisioning [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Network access issues affecting a limited number of users in Myanmar [monitoring]
item.description: We continue to try to resolve this issue. We have made official requests for resolution to the appropriate parties in Myanmar.

item.title: Sign-in failures for `signInWithIdToken` (OIDC) logins on free-tier projects [resolved]
item.description: We have confirmed that the fix has been effective and are marking this incident as resolved.

item.title: Project creation failing in selected regions [resolved]
item.description: We have identified this as a non-user impacting alert and as such this is being resolved.

item.title: Project access, updating and creation impacted in us-east-2 [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: 401 errors due to JWT rejections [identified]
item.description: We continue to monitor progress and are slowly updating each region. Thank you for your patience on this issue.

item.title: MCP connection error to branch environments [resolved]
item.description: Customers should now be able to connect to branch environments via MCP normally.

item.title: Project Upgrade Delays [resolved]
item.description: Project upgrades have remained stable, we are resolving this incident.

item.title: Management API Performance Degradation [resolved]
item.description: After monitoring, we have confirmed that issues affecting Management API performance have been resolved.

item.title: DNS creation delays [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved.

item.title: Log Ingestion Issues [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved, and customers should now see new logs appearing as expected.

item.title: Management API Performance Degradation [resolved]
item.description: The intermittent networking issues have subsided. Management-api is operating normally now.

item.title: Issues with Edge Function Deployment [resolved]
item.description:
A preventative fix (Supabase CLI v2.111.0 ) has been released to ensure that new Function deployments are not affected. As the underlying issue has been addressed and new deployments should no longer be affected, we are resolving this incident.
All impacted users are now able to re-deploy their Functions again. In exceptional cases, Support will continue working directly with customers who require additional remediation.

item.title: SSO login failures in us-east-1 [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. SSO login functionality in the us-east-1 region has returned to normal, and all services are operating as expected.

item.title: Documents Search Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: Documentation search functionality has been restored.

item.title: Delays in creation of DNS records [resolved]
item.description: This incident is resolved. DNS creation for new projects has been fixed since 20:35 UTC. Backfill of missing DNS records has been completed at 22:20 UTC. Please contact Support if your project seems impacted by missing DNS records.

item.title: Project Resize Problems in US-West-2 [resolved]
item.description: Project resizing has maintained expected performance in us-west-2.

item.title: Authentication issues for some projects [resolved]
item.description: Authentication operations have returned to normal consistently.
